hypothesis: Exact-position crowding is amplified by ordinary voice interactions requiring identical cell and z. Allowing adjacent voice reach, choosing low-occupancy rendezvous positions, and adding a non-acute spatial-comfort need above two exact-position occupants should reduce crowding without reducing physical-action validity or social development.
acceptance: Most paired endpoints reduce maximum exact-position occupancy or occupancy excess.
Adjacent teaching and exchange acceptance complete while adjacent person-to-person transfer remains blocked.
Living population, teaching, fulfilled agreements, and completed joint projects show no systematic collapse across paired seeds.
revision: Crowding remains materially unchanged in most paired endpoints while relocation actions rarely occur.
Social outcomes regress consistently even when survival is stable.
rejection: Physical person interactions become legal without exact co-location.
Any run gains impossible communication, state corruption, or a new deterministic deadlock.
